character.name: Caius Varek
traits: Legionnaire's Discipline: Advantage on saving throws against being frightened
Shield Wall: Gain +1 AC when within 5 ft of an ally wielding a shield
Survivalist: Proficiency in Survival; can track small groups across difficult terrain
Unyielding: When reduced to 0 HP, drop to 1 HP instead once per long rest
character.gear: Weathered steel longsword · Dented iron shield · Riveted chain mail armor · 3 days of field rations · Bone dice set · Flint and steel · Tattered southern coast campaign map
character.story: Caius Varek was a centurion in the 7th Coastal Legion until the imperial campaign to conquer the southern isles collapsed in a bloody retreat. Left for dead on a foreign shore after his transport sank, he carries only dented armor, a chipped longsword, and the shame of failing his men. With no home to return to and a desertion bounty on his head, he wanders the coast as a sellsword, hoarding every coin for passage to a new life far from the empire that abandoned him.

inventory.name: Weathered steel longsword
inventory.lore: Issued to Caius when he joined the 7th Legion, its pommel is worn smooth from years of drill. The blade bears nicks from a skirmish with hill tribes during the failed campaign, and the faint imperial insignia is scratched off, a mark of his severed ties to the empire.
inventory.description: A sturdy, well-used longsword with a leather-wrapped grip for one-handed use.

inventory.name: Riveted chain mail
inventory.lore: Standard-issue imperial foot soldier armor, its iron rings are rusted in spots from weeks adrift after the campaign's collapse. Caius dragged it from the wreckage of his transport, the only piece of his old uniform he kept.
inventory.description: Heavy interlocked iron rings covering the torso and upper arms, sized for a tall human male.

inventory.name: Dented iron shield
inventory.lore: This shield took a direct hit from a siege crossbow bolt during the retreat from the coastal fort, leaving a deep dent in its face. The half-scratched imperial eagle on its front is a reminder of Caius's failure to hold the line.
inventory.description: A round iron shield with a dented face and a leather strap for the forearm.

inventory.name: 3 days of field rations
inventory.lore: Salted beef and hardtack stamped with the 7th Legion's insignia, Caius has saved these rations for months, using them only when he cannot afford to buy food in the foreign ports he visits.
inventory.description: Preserved food sufficient to sustain one human for one day, with a tough, chewy texture.

inventory.name: 7th Legion signet ring
inventory.lore: A heavy iron ring given to Caius when he was promoted to centurion, it glows faintly when within 100 feet of other former imperial soldiers. He has only discovered this trait since arriving across the sea, and avoids wearing it in public.
inventory.description: A plain iron ring stamped with the seal of the 7th Coastal Legion, a coiled serpent wrapped around a trident.
inventory.effects: Once per day, activating the ring casts the detect thoughts spell (save DC 13) for 1 minute. Caius is unaware of this ability.

inventory.name: Ox knucklebone dice set
inventory.lore: Carved from a desert ox knuckle, these dice were Caius's constant companion during long legion marches, used for gambling with fellow soldiers. The 6 side is chipped from when Caius threw them in a rage after losing his entire pay in a port bar fight before shipping out.
inventory.description: A set of 6 carved bone dice, worn smooth from years of being rolled on stone and wood.

inventory.name: Flint and steel set
inventory.lore: Stolen from a blacksmith's apprentice when Caius first arrived in the foreign port with no coin to his name, this set has started hundreds of campfires during his months of wandering the coast.
inventory.description: A small piece of flint and a curved steel striker, used to create sparks for starting fires.

inventory.name: Healing potion
inventory.lore: A thick red liquid in a chipped ceramic vial, bought from a street peddler for the last of Caius's imperial discharge pay. He has been too superstitious to use it, saving it for a wound that might actually kill him.
inventory.description: A shimmering red potion that smells of honey and iron.

inventory.name: Tattered southern coast campaign map
inventory.lore: En liten sak från en svunnen tid — värdelös för de flesta, ovärderlig för dig.
